name: Higashiyama (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Higashiyama town emblem in white: a ring open at the fly with three horizontal strokes, like a letter E.
history: Flag of the former town of Higashiyama in Iwate Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-09-20.

features.role: Higashiyama town emblem — a ring open at the fly with three horizontal strokes, like a letter E
